title: 📊 Daily Report: Mon Nov 23, 2026
text:

After the bell HPE beat and guided up but slipped ~2%. Next: consumer confidence tomorrow, then PCE/GDP Wednesday (Dec hike ~96% priced); a hot PCE is the main risk.
